response.justification: While Bogdan is an experienced and talented senior developer with excellent communication skills and CI/CD expertise, he lacks the critical mandatory requirements for this specialized capital markets role. His C++ experience is limited to approximately 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015), far short of the required 5-10 years of hands-on development. His recent career (last 5+ years) has focused on TypeScript, Node.js, and web systems rather than C++ or Windows platforms. Critically, he has zero experience in capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or related financial domains, and no demonstrated expertise in SQL Server or Oracle databases. The skill and domain gaps are too significant to warrant consideration.
strengths: Exceptional professional maturity with 20 years of engineering experience and proven leadership across diverse technical challenges
Outstanding communication abilities demonstrated through multiple technical workshops, conference talks, and mentoring initiatives
Strong CI/CD and infrastructure background with GitLab, Docker, and deployment automation experience
concerns: Critically insufficient C++ experience—approximately 6 months at National Instruments (2014-2015) falls far short of the mandatory 5-10 years requirement
Complete absence of capital markets, fixed income, investment banking, or financial services domain expertise; career focused on web platforms, GIS, and media
Recent 5+ year career trajectory entirely in TypeScript/Node.js web development with no Windows platform or SQL Server/Oracle database experience
